steps.name: The packaged app shows the 3D view panel for the project opened on the command line
A canvas with a real size is drawn and no graphics-failure alert is shown
The object list and the camera buttons are present
Selecting an object marks its row
Every camera view button can be pressed
Mouse drags (all buttons, with modifiers), wheel and keys change nothing in the object list
Leaving the page removes the canvas
Nothing left the machine (no non-loopback request)
No CSP violation or graphics-context problem was logged
The project file bytes are unchanged
